name: mem-tool
description: The main agent (off mode, Ask each time) calls the memory tool seven times through the synthetic endpoint: save a fact (this project), save a fact at user level, save a TASTE rule (these three as asked), update the fact, a refused call (a TASTE rule at user level), delete the TASTE rule and save a fact on its own (no asked: added by Mori). After each successful call the Memory page reads what View in Memory opens. Mori restarts, the session is opened again and two cards are followed again (the deleted TASTE entry reads as null).
